title: ENGR 346: Analog Electronics
summary: Feedback systems, amplifier circuits, op-amp topologies, and noise-aware analog design.

cover.alt: Open purple notebook with a pen beside colour-swatch cards

sections.heading: Overview
paragraphs: Applied network theorems to analyze and design feedback systems and amplifier circuits, with emphasis on frequency response and stability. Explored common op-amp topologies and their real-world behaviors.
Gained foundational knowledge in switch-mode power supplies and electrical noise sources, developing insight into noise-aware analog system design.
